answer: Sybil resistance via echo verification with terraced reputation. Each identity must echo a fresh nonce in its attestation, proving live control, so a dormant farm of fakes can't attest on schedule. Reputation sits on a 'terrace' of cumulative earned tiers, where a fake can't jump levels without real work. A 'cedar' persistence rule: reputation roots must survive multiple epochs with continuous contribution, so a sybil that stops acting loses its deep-rooted standing. Attacker cost: live echoing plus a multi-epoch climb with no shortcuts.
